definition: Systems that add repeatable workflows, cross-session state, deterministic quality gates, specialist agents, and enforcement above the host coding-agent runtime — not generic AI coding assistants, foundation-model labs, or single-step SDLC tools. Closest comps orchestrate full or multi-phase software delivery and DevOps cycles as composable, host-integrated process layers (plugins, skills, hooks).
jobs_to_be_done: Enforce a full SDLC or DevOps cycle so agents cannot skip planning, verification, review, or release steps
Compose specialist agents and external workflows (GSD, spec kits, review ladders) under one compliance layer
Persist process state, gates, and evidence across sessions and parallel workers
Provide procurement-ready comparison of process-orchestration depth vs host runtimes and frameworks

notes: Multi-market membership is NOT mutually exclusive: a solution may be core (or adjacent) in one OR multiple markets when evidence supports it (e.g. Silver Bullet is APO core and sdlc-plugins core). Do not force exclusive single-market placement. Multi-market pack (APO primary, SDLC plugins secondary, agentic SDLC SaaS tertiary). Host runtimes (Cursor/Claude Code/Codex/Copilot) are SaaS-adjacent only — never MQ/Wave core. Devin is agentic-sdlc-saas core (MQ/Wave Leader) and APO-adjacent autonomous SWE — not SaaS adjacent-only and not an APO process-orchestrator peer. Claude Harness, cc10x, Cavekit v3.1, and Barkain are sdlc-plugins OSS (Claude Code plugin class — not APO commercial core). AgentHub is APO-adjacent client-automation CRM, not APO core. A.Team/ATeam is excluded (FDE/professional services, not APO). Conductor is SaaS-adjacent aggregator (not APO). cc10x is sdlc-plugins Claude Code plugin (not APO). Director is APO seed with unverified identity and no shipped hook gates in features.json (Niche/low-execute, not a plugin and not an aggregator). MetaGPT is APO OSS core (not generic-framework adjacent). Magic.dev is hard-excluded coding_agent (boilerplate SCR — not SaaS core, not MQ/Wave). Zuvo is sdlc-plugins core (homepage https://zuvo.dev/; GitHub greglas75/zuvo). Inclusion: ≥3/7 APO; ≥2/5 secondary/tertiary. Tembo is demoted to agentic-sdlc-saas adjacent (not SaaS core plotted).
